alternativas.b: Uma pessoa morta ou ferida, geralmente em um acidente ou guerra.
alternativas.c: Uma coincidência inesperada, sentido oposto ao explicado no texto.
alternativas.d: Um evento organizado sem planejamento prévio, ideia ausente do texto.

questoes.explicacao: O texto explica que 'casualty' se refere a uma vítima (morta ou ferida), e não a uma coincidência, que em inglês corresponde a 'coincidence' ou 'chance'.

questoes.texto_apoio: Coastal towns around the world are watching their beaches shrink as rising seas and stronger storms have eroded the shoreline at an alarming pace. Local governments face difficult decisions about whether to build expensive seawalls, relocate vulnerable buildings, or simply let nature reclaim the land.
questoes.enunciado: In the text, the word 'eroded' is closest in meaning to:

alternativas.a: expanded and strengthened
alternativas.b: permanently frozen
alternativas.c: gradually worn away
alternativas.d: artificially rebuilt

questoes.explicacao: O contexto associa 'eroded' ao encolhimento das praias causado pelo aumento do nível do mar e tempestades, indicando um processo de desgaste gradual, e não de expansão ou reconstrução.

questoes.texto_apoio: Companies producing lab-grown meat from animal cells claim their products could reduce the environmental footprint of the meat industry significantly. However, scaling up production remains a major challenge: current methods are expensive, and regulatory approval varies widely from country to country, slowing wider commercial availability.
questoes.enunciado: What is the main idea of the text?

alternativas.a: Lab-grown meat is already sold everywhere at prices lower than traditional meat.
alternativas.b: Lab-grown meat remains unavailable everywhere because it has a larger environmental footprint than traditional meat.
alternativas.c: The meat industry has abandoned traditional production entirely in favor of lab-grown alternatives.
alternativas.d: Lab-grown meat offers environmental promise but still faces obstacles related to cost and regulation.

questoes.explicacao: O texto reconhece o potencial ambiental da carne cultivada em laboratório, mas destaca desafios de custo e regulação que ainda dificultam sua disponibilidade comercial mais ampla.

questoes.texto_apoio: Many companies now label their products as 'eco-friendly' or 'sustainable' without providing any verifiable evidence to support these claims. This practice, often used simply to attract environmentally conscious consumers, misleads buyers who believe they are making a responsible choice while the underlying production process remains largely unchanged.
questoes.enunciado: What tone does the author adopt when describing this marketing practice?

alternativas.a: Neutral, simply describing a common industry trend with no judgment.
alternativas.b: Critical, exposing a gap between marketing claims and actual practices.
alternativas.c: Amused, treating the practice as a harmless joke, unlike the actual tone.
alternativas.d: Approving, praising companies for their environmental commitment.

questoes.explicacao: Ao afirmar que rótulos são usados 'sem qualquer evidência verificável' e que a prática 'engana os compradores', o autor adota um tom claramente crítico em relação ao chamado greenwashing.

questoes.texto_apoio: The word 'deception' is a false cognate that confuses many Portuguese speakers. It does not mean 'decepção' (disappointment). Instead, 'deception' refers to the act of deliberately misleading someone, as in 'the scheme relied on deception to steal money from victims'. The word for 'decepção' is 'disappointment'.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does 'deception' mean in English?

alternativas.a: Um sentimento de tristeza após uma expectativa não realizada.
alternativas.b: Uma recusa educada de um convite.
alternativas.c: Um pedido de desculpas formal.
alternativas.d: O ato deliberado de enganar alguém.

questoes.explicacao: O texto esclarece que 'deception' significa o ato de enganar deliberadamente, e não 'decepção' (sentimento de desapontamento), que em inglês corresponde a 'disappointment'.

questoes.texto_apoio: Large quantities of electronic waste from wealthier nations are shipped to developing countries, officially labeled as used goods for resale. Once there, much of this equipment turns out to be broken beyond repair, and it is often dismantled by informal workers who extract valuable metals using methods that expose them to toxic substances.
questoes.enunciado: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the labeling of electronic waste as 'used goods for resale'?

alternativas.a: It has completely eliminated informal electronic waste processing worldwide.
alternativas.b: It accurately reflects the actual condition of all the equipment being shipped.
alternativas.c: It may serve as a way to bypass stricter regulations on the export of hazardous waste.
alternativas.d: It guarantees that workers who handle the equipment are fully protected from toxic exposure.

questoes.explicacao: O texto revela que grande parte do equipamento rotulado como 'usado para revenda' está, na verdade, quebrado, o que permite inferir que essa classificação pode servir para contornar regras mais rígidas sobre exportação de resíduos perigosos.

questoes.texto_apoio: The term 'quiet quitting' describes employees who do only the minimum required by their job description, avoiding extra tasks or overtime that is not properly compensated. Supporters see it as a healthy boundary against overwork, while some employers view it as a lack of commitment that can hurt team morale.
questoes.enunciado: What is the main idea of the text?

alternativas.a: Quiet quitting means literally resigning from a job without informing the employer, contrary to the text.
alternativas.b: All employers strongly support the practice of quiet quitting among their staff, unlike the text.
alternativas.c: Quiet quitting refers to doing only the required tasks at work, a practice viewed differently by employees and employers.
alternativas.d: Quiet quitting has been made illegal in most workplaces, which the text does not state.

questoes.explicacao: O texto define 'quiet quitting' como fazer apenas o mínimo exigido pelo cargo, apresentando duas visões: como forma saudável de evitar sobrecarga ou como falta de comprometimento, sem afirmar que se trata de pedir demissão literalmente.

questoes.texto_apoio: In English, 'educated' does not necessarily mean 'educado' (polite). 'Educated' refers to someone who has received formal schooling or instruction, as in 'a highly educated professional'. The word closer to the Portuguese 'educado', in the sense of good manners, is 'polite' or 'well-mannered'.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does 'educated' mean in English?

alternativas.a: Alguém que trabalha exclusivamente como professor.
alternativas.b: Alguém com boas maneiras e comportamento cortês.
alternativas.c: Alguém que nunca cometeu erros de etiqueta.
alternativas.d: Alguém que recebeu instrução formal ou escolarização.

questoes.explicacao: O texto explica que 'educated' se refere à instrução formal recebida por uma pessoa, e não a boas maneiras, sentido para o qual o inglês usa 'polite' ou 'well-mannered'.

questoes.texto_apoio: Restoring a centuries-old painting requires meticulous work: conservators use magnifying tools to remove layers of old varnish without damaging the original pigments underneath, a process that can take months for a single canvas. Even a small mistake can permanently alter a work that has survived for hundreds of years.
questoes.enunciado: In the text, the word 'meticulous' is closest in meaning to:

alternativas.a: completely automated, with no human involvement
alternativas.b: occasional and infrequent, unlike the described process
alternativas.c: extremely careful and precise
alternativas.d: careless and rushed, contrary to the text

questoes.explicacao: O contexto descreve um processo delicado, no qual até um pequeno erro pode alterar permanentemente a obra, o que reforça o sentido de 'meticulous' como extremamente cuidadoso e preciso.

questoes.texto_apoio: A recent study found that teenagers who use smartphones in bed take significantly longer to fall asleep than those who do not. The same study also found that the content viewed mattered less than the light emitted by the screen itself, since even silent, non-stimulating apps delayed sleep onset by a similar amount.
questoes.enunciado: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the cause of delayed sleep among smartphone users?

alternativas.a: Silent apps have been proven to help teenagers fall asleep faster, which contradicts the study.
alternativas.b: The screen's light itself may play a larger role in delaying sleep than the specific content being viewed.
alternativas.c: Only exciting or stimulating content on smartphones affects sleep onset, contrary to the study.
alternativas.d: Smartphones have no measurable effect on how quickly teenagers fall asleep, contrary to the study.

questoes.explicacao: O texto indica que mesmo aplicativos silenciosos e pouco estimulantes atrasaram o sono de forma semelhante, permitindo inferir que a luz da tela, e não apenas o conteúdo, é um fator relevante nesse atraso.

questoes.texto_apoio: The adjective 'ingenious' is a false cognate for Portuguese speakers. It does not mean 'ingênuo' (naive). 'Ingenious' describes something clever or inventive, as in 'an ingenious solution to a complex problem'. The word for 'ingênuo' is 'naive'.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does 'ingenious' mean in English?

alternativas.a: Engenhoso, criativo e inventivo.
alternativas.b: Simples demais, sem originalidade.
alternativas.c: Ingênuo, facilmente enganado.
alternativas.d: Desonesto ou pouco confiável.

questoes.explicacao: O texto esclarece que 'ingenious' significa engenhoso/criativo, e não 'ingênuo' (naive), configurando outro exemplo de falso cognato relevante para estudantes de inglês.

questoes.texto_apoio: As the amount of debris orbiting Earth continues to grow, a specialized mission has been designed to capture defunct satellites using a robotic arm and safely guide them back into the atmosphere, where they burn up. Engineers hope the mission will serve as a model for future cleanup efforts in increasingly crowded orbits.
questoes.enunciado: What is the main idea of the text?

alternativas.a: A new mission aims to remove defunct satellites from orbit and could serve as a model for future cleanup.
alternativas.b: This mission was designed exclusively to prevent new satellites from ever being launched into orbit.
alternativas.c: This mission proves that space debris no longer poses any risk to functioning satellites.
alternativas.d: Space debris no longer poses any risk to satellites or spacecraft, contrary to the text.

questoes.explicacao: O texto descreve uma missão criada especificamente para capturar satélites inativos e removê-los da órbita, apontando essa iniciativa como possível modelo para futuros esforços de limpeza espacial.

questoes.texto_apoio: Volunteers in a once-barren region have planted millions of native trees over the past decade, and the transformation has been remarkable: streams that had dried up decades ago are flowing again, and wildlife once thought to have disappeared from the area has begun to return.
questoes.enunciado: What tone does the author adopt when describing the reforestation project?

alternativas.a: Skeptical, doubting whether the project produced any real change.
alternativas.b: Indifferent, treating the results as unremarkable, unlike the actual tone.
alternativas.c: Hopeful, celebrating the positive transformation achieved by the project.
alternativas.d: Critical, blaming volunteers for the region's earlier deforestation.

questoes.explicacao: Termos como 'remarkable' e a descrição do retorno de riachos e da fauna revelam um tom otimista e celebratório em relação aos resultados do projeto de reflorestamento.

questoes.texto_apoio: In English, 'journal' does not mean 'jornal' (newspaper). A 'journal' can refer to a personal diary or to a specialized academic publication, as in 'a scientific journal'. The word for 'jornal' in the sense of a daily newspaper is 'newspaper'.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does the word 'journal' mean in English?

alternativas.a: Um jornal diário de notícias gerais, sentido que o texto rejeita.
alternativas.b: Um diário pessoal ou uma publicação acadêmica especializada.
alternativas.c: Um canal de televisão dedicado a notícias, ideia ausente do texto.
alternativas.d: Um cartaz publicitário distribuído nas ruas, o que o texto não confirma.

questoes.explicacao: O texto explica que 'journal' pode ser um diário pessoal ou uma revista acadêmica, e não um jornal diário de notícias, que em inglês corresponde a 'newspaper'.

questoes.texto_apoio: Fishing fleets around the world are reporting dwindling catches of several once-abundant species, a trend scientists attribute to decades of overfishing combined with warming ocean temperatures. Some governments have imposed stricter quotas, though enforcement remains inconsistent in international waters.
questoes.enunciado: In the text, the word 'dwindling' is closest in meaning to:

alternativas.a: steadily growing
alternativas.b: remaining constant
alternativas.c: suddenly disappearing overnight
alternativas.d: gradually decreasing

questoes.explicacao: O contexto relaciona 'dwindling' à sobrepesca e ao aquecimento dos oceanos ao longo de décadas, indicando uma diminuição gradual, e não uma queda súbita ou estabilidade.

questoes.texto_apoio: A company using artificial intelligence to screen job applicants found that its system consistently ranked candidates from certain universities higher than others, even when qualifications were nearly identical. Investigators later discovered that the algorithm had been trained mostly on resumes of employees hired in the past, a group that lacked diversity in educational background.
questoes.enunciado: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the source of the algorithm's bias?

alternativas.a: The algorithm was designed intentionally to exclude certain universities from consideration, contrary to the text.
alternativas.b: Candidates from certain universities were objectively less qualified than others, an idea the text refutes.
alternativas.c: The company has never hired anyone from a diverse educational background, contrary to the text's implication.
alternativas.d: The bias likely resulted from training data that reflected the company's own historical lack of diversity, rather than deliberate design.

questoes.explicacao: Ao conectar o treinamento do algoritmo com currículos de contratações passadas pouco diversas, o texto permite inferir que o viés resultou dessa base de dados histórica, e não de uma intenção deliberada de exclusão.

questoes.texto_apoio: The word 'mayor' is a false cognate that confuses Portuguese speakers. It does not mean 'maior' (bigger, larger). A 'mayor' is the elected head of a city or town government. The word for 'maior', as a comparative adjective, is 'bigger' or 'larger'.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does the word 'mayor' mean in English?

alternativas.a: Algo de tamanho superior a outro.
alternativas.b: O membro mais velho de uma família.
alternativas.c: Um título honorário sem função administrativa.
alternativas.d: O chefe eleito do governo de uma cidade.

questoes.explicacao: O texto esclarece que 'mayor' se refere ao prefeito de uma cidade, e não a 'maior' no sentido de tamanho, que em inglês corresponde a 'bigger' ou 'larger'.

questoes.texto_apoio: Some clothing brands have introduced take-back programs, encouraging customers to return old garments in exchange for store credit. The returned items are then repaired, resold, or broken down into raw materials for new products, an approach known as a circular economy model that aims to keep clothing in use for as long as possible.
questoes.enunciado: What is the main idea of the text?

alternativas.a: All clothing brands have stopped selling new products entirely.
alternativas.b: Recycling clothing into raw materials is technically impossible.
alternativas.c: Some brands are adopting circular economy practices to extend the life cycle of clothing.
alternativas.d: Take-back programs are designed to discourage customers from returning to the same stores.

questoes.explicacao: O texto descreve programas de devolução de roupas usadas que são reparadas, revendidas ou recicladas, caracterizando uma abordagem de economia circular voltada a prolongar a vida útil das peças.

questoes.texto_apoio: Satellite images comparing different neighborhoods within the same city revealed that areas with dense tree cover recorded temperatures up to six degrees lower than neighborhoods dominated by asphalt and concrete, even on the same afternoon. Researchers noted that the neighborhoods with the least tree cover were also, in most cases, historically lower-income areas.
questoes.enunciado: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the relationship between tree cover and income levels within cities?

alternativas.a: The neighborhoods with the least tree cover in the study happened to be the wealthiest ones historically.
alternativas.b: Lower-income neighborhoods may be disproportionately exposed to higher temperatures due to reduced tree cover.
alternativas.c: Higher-income neighborhoods always have more asphalt and concrete than lower-income ones.
alternativas.d: Temperature differences between neighborhoods in the same city are impossible to measure.

questoes.explicacao: O texto liga a menor cobertura arbórea a bairros historicamente de menor renda e a temperaturas mais altas, permitindo inferir uma exposição desigual ao calor urbano associada a fatores socioeconômicos.

questoes.texto_apoio: In English, 'policy' does not mean 'polícia' (the police force). Instead, 'policy' refers to a course of action adopted by a government or organization, as in 'the company's new policy on remote work'. The word for 'polícia' is 'police'.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does the word 'policy' mean in English?

alternativas.a: A força policial responsável pela segurança pública.
alternativas.b: Um curso de ação adotado por um governo ou organização.
alternativas.c: Um tribunal responsável por julgar crimes.
alternativas.d: Um uniforme usado por agentes de segurança.

questoes.explicacao: O texto explica que 'policy' se refere a uma diretriz ou curso de ação adotado por um governo ou organização, e não à polícia, que em inglês corresponde a 'police'.

questoes.texto_apoio: After several leaks revealed how much personal data was being collected without users' full understanding, a major tech company came under intense scrutiny from regulators and privacy advocates alike. Lawmakers in multiple countries have since proposed stricter rules requiring clearer consent before companies can collect or share user information.
questoes.enunciado: In the text, the word 'scrutiny' is closest in meaning to:

alternativas.a: close and critical examination
alternativas.b: praise and admiration, opposite to the context
alternativas.c: complete indifference, unlike the reaction described
alternativas.d: financial investment, unrelated to the context

questoes.explicacao: O contexto associa 'scrutiny' à atenção de reguladores e defensores da privacidade após vazamentos de dados, indicando um exame minucioso e crítico, e não elogio ou indiferença.

questoes.texto_apoio: Some companies have begun offering paid menstrual leave, allowing employees to take time off during particularly painful periods without using regular sick days. Supporters say the policy acknowledges a real biological need, while critics worry it could reinforce workplace stereotypes or be misused by employers to justify not hiring women.
questoes.enunciado: What is the main idea of the text?

alternativas.a: Menstrual leave policies address a biological need but also raise concerns about potential workplace discrimination.
alternativas.b: According to the text, the critics who worried about workplace stereotypes have already reversed their opinion.
alternativas.c: No company in the world currently offers any form of menstrual leave.
alternativas.d: Menstrual leave was created specifically to replace sick leave entirely for all employees, not only during painful periods.

questoes.explicacao: O texto apresenta tanto o argumento favorável (reconhecimento de uma necessidade biológica) quanto a preocupação crítica (possível reforço de estereótipos ou discriminação), sem indicar consenso total.

questoes.texto_apoio: Gene editing techniques now allow scientists to correct mutations responsible for certain hereditary diseases before a child is born. While the medical potential is significant, many researchers urge caution, warning that editing genes passed on to future generations raises ethical questions that society has not yet fully addressed.
questoes.enunciado: What tone does the author adopt when describing gene editing technology?

alternativas.a: Purely celebratory, with no mention of any concerns, unlike the actual tone.
alternativas.b: Completely dismissive of the technology's medical value.
alternativas.c: Sarcastic, mocking scientists who study gene editing.
alternativas.d: Cautiously balanced, acknowledging both potential and ethical concerns.

questoes.explicacao: O texto reconhece o potencial médico da edição genética, mas também destaca o pedido de cautela dos pesquisadores diante de questões éticas ainda não resolvidas, revelando um tom equilibrado e cauteloso.

questoes.texto_apoio: The word 'preservative' is a well-known false cognate. It does not mean 'preservativo' (condom). A 'preservative' is a chemical substance added to food or other products to prevent spoilage, as in 'this bread contains no artificial preservatives'. The word for 'preservativo' in Portuguese is 'condom' in English.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does the word 'preservative' mean in English?

alternativas.a: Um método contraceptivo de barreira, sentido que o texto rejeita.
alternativas.b: Um tipo de embalagem reciclável, ideia ausente do texto.
alternativas.c: Um conservante utilizado exclusivamente em cosméticos.
alternativas.d: Uma substância química adicionada a alimentos para evitar deterioração.

questoes.explicacao: O texto esclarece que 'preservative' significa conservante alimentar, e não 'preservativo' (condom), sendo um dos falsos cognatos mais conhecidos e relevantes entre estudantes brasileiros.

questoes.texto_apoio: As more employees work from home permanently, small businesses that once relied on foot traffic from office workers, such as lunch spots and dry cleaners near business districts, have reported sharp declines in revenue. Some downtown areas are now exploring converting empty office buildings into residential apartments to bring people back to these neighborhoods.
questoes.enunciado: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the strategy of converting office buildings into apartments?

alternativas.a: It aims to convert every office building in the city into residential apartments within the next year.
alternativas.b: It has no connection to the decline in downtown business revenue.
alternativas.c: It is intended to attract residents who could replace the foot traffic lost from remote workers.
alternativas.d: This conversion strategy was created mainly to encourage even more employees to work permanently from home.

questoes.explicacao: O texto conecta o declínio de negócios locais à ausência de trabalhadores presenciais e apresenta a conversão de escritórios em apartamentos como forma de trazer novos moradores, o que permite inferir a intenção de repor o fluxo de pessoas perdido.

questoes.texto_apoio: In English, 'to retire' does not mean 'retirar' (to remove or take away). Instead, 'to retire' means to stop working, usually after reaching a certain age, as in 'she plans to retire at sixty-five'. The verb for 'retirar' in the sense of removing something is 'to remove' or 'to withdraw'.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does the verb 'to retire' mean in English?

alternativas.a: Remover ou retirar um objeto de um lugar, sentido que o texto rejeita.
alternativas.b: Desistir de um projeto no meio de sua execução.
alternativas.c: Parar de trabalhar, geralmente após atingir certa idade.
alternativas.d: Recusar uma oferta de emprego, ideia ausente do texto.

questoes.explicacao: O texto explica que 'to retire' significa se aposentar, e não 'retirar' (remover), que em inglês corresponde a 'to remove' ou 'to withdraw'.

questoes.texto_apoio: Open-plan offices, once praised for encouraging collaboration, are increasingly criticized for constant noise and interruptions that make focused work difficult. In response, many companies have installed noise-canceling phone booths and quiet zones, allowing employees to escape the open floor when deep concentration is required.
questoes.enunciado: What is the main idea of the text?

alternativas.a: In response to noise-related criticism of open-plan offices, some companies now offer quiet spaces for focused work.
alternativas.b: The text states that installing quiet zones has completely resolved every noise-related complaint in modern workplaces.
alternativas.c: Noise-canceling phone booths were installed to replace open-plan collaboration entirely, eliminating open floors.
alternativas.d: Open-plan offices are now criticized because they were originally designed to reduce collaboration among employees.

questoes.explicacao: O texto descreve a crítica ao ruído dos escritórios abertos e a resposta de algumas empresas, que passaram a instalar cabines e zonas silenciosas para permitir foco, sem indicar abandono total do modelo aberto.

questoes.texto_apoio: When a popular platform announced a redesign that removed a long-standing feature many users relied on daily, the backlash was immediate: thousands of users flooded social media with complaints, and some threatened to switch to competing services entirely.
questoes.enunciado: In the text, the word 'backlash' is closest in meaning to:

alternativas.a: an official government investigation, unrelated to the context
alternativas.b: an enthusiastic wave of support, opposite to the reaction described
alternativas.c: a gradual and unnoticed change, unlike the immediate reaction
alternativas.d: a strong negative reaction from a group of people

questoes.explicacao: O contexto mostra usuários reclamando e ameaçando migrar para concorrentes, o que caracteriza 'backlash' como uma forte reação negativa de um grupo de pessoas.

questoes.texto_apoio: Ornithologists have found that migratory birds relying on starlight and moonlight for navigation become disoriented near brightly lit cities, sometimes colliding with buildings or circling illuminated towers until exhausted. Some cities have started turning off non-essential lights during peak migration seasons in response to these findings.
questoes.enunciado: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the relationship between artificial light and bird navigation?

alternativas.a: Artificial light improves birds' ability to navigate accurately during migration, contrary to the text.
alternativas.b: Excessive artificial light can interfere with the natural cues birds use to navigate, sometimes with harmful consequences.
alternativas.c: Birds no longer rely on any natural light source for navigation, which directly contradicts the text.
alternativas.d: Turning off city lights has no effect on bird behavior during migration, which the text disputes.

questoes.explicacao: O texto liga a desorientação das aves à luz artificial das cidades, e a resposta de desligar luzes durante a migração reforça a inferência de que o excesso de luz interfere nos sinais naturais usados pelas aves para se orientar.

questoes.texto_apoio: In English, 'sympathetic' does not mean 'simpático' (nice, likeable). Instead, 'sympathetic' describes someone who shows understanding or compassion toward another person's difficulties, as in 'the teacher was sympathetic to the student's situation'. The word closer to the Portuguese 'simpático' is 'nice', 'friendly', or 'likeable'.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does the word 'sympathetic' mean in English?

alternativas.a: Indiferente aos problemas alheios, sentido oposto ao do texto.
alternativas.b: Compreensivo, solidário diante das dificuldades de alguém.
alternativas.c: Engraçado e bem-humorado, sentido que o texto rejeita.
alternativas.d: Simpático, agradável no primeiro contato, sentido que o texto nega para essa palavra.

questoes.explicacao: O texto esclarece que 'sympathetic' significa compreensivo/solidário, e não 'simpático' no sentido de agradável, que em inglês corresponde a 'nice', 'friendly' ou 'likeable'.

questoes.texto_apoio: One of the most surprising false cognates for Portuguese speakers is 'constipated'. It does not mean 'constipado' (having a cold, with a stuffy nose). In English, 'constipated' describes someone who has difficulty emptying their bowels. The word for the Portuguese 'constipado' is 'having a cold' or 'congested'.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does 'constipated' mean in English?

alternativas.a: Ter dificuldade para evacuar.
alternativas.b: Estar gripado, com o nariz entupido.
alternativas.c: Estar com febre alta.
alternativas.d: Sentir dor de cabeça intensa.

questoes.explicacao: O texto esclarece que 'constipated', em inglês, refere-se à dificuldade de evacuar, e não a estar resfriado, o que corresponde à expressão 'having a cold' — um falso cognato que costuma causar situações embaraçosas.

questoes.texto_apoio: Low-lying coastal cities, home to hundreds of millions of people, are among the most vulnerable places on the planet to rising sea levels. Even a modest increase in average sea level can worsen flooding during storms, contaminate freshwater supplies with salt, and force costly investments in barriers and drainage systems.
questoes.enunciado: In the text, the word 'vulnerable' is closest in meaning to:

alternativas.a: exposed to potential harm or damage
alternativas.b: completely protected from any risk
alternativas.c: unaffected by environmental changes
alternativas.d: responsible for causing a problem

questoes.explicacao: O contexto associa 'vulnerable' a cidades sujeitas a inundações, contaminação de água doce e altos custos com barreiras, indicando exposição a danos potenciais, e não proteção ou responsabilidade.

questoes.texto_apoio: Telemedicine expanded rapidly, allowing patients to consult doctors remotely through video calls. Yet access remains uneven: patients without reliable internet or a smartphone, often in rural or low-income areas, are frequently unable to benefit from this technology, even though these are sometimes the same populations that live farthest from physical clinics.
questoes.enunciado: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the overall impact of telemedicine on healthcare access?

alternativas.a: Telemedicine has completely eliminated healthcare inequality between rural and urban populations.
alternativas.b: Telemedicine may fail to reach precisely the populations that could benefit from it the most, due to lack of connectivity.
alternativas.c: Rural populations always have better internet access than urban populations, contrary to the text.
alternativas.d: Physical clinics have become entirely unnecessary since the rise of telemedicine, which the text disputes.

questoes.explicacao: O texto aponta que populações sem internet confiável, muitas vezes as mesmas que vivem mais longe de clínicas físicas, ficam sem acesso à telemedicina, permitindo inferir que a tecnologia pode não alcançar justamente quem mais precisaria dela.

questoes.texto_apoio: In English, 'confident' does not mean 'confidente' (a person who is trusted with secrets). 'Confident' describes someone who feels sure of themselves or of a particular outcome, as in 'she felt confident about the exam'. The word for 'confidente' in Portuguese is 'confidant' in English.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does the adjective 'confident' mean in English?

alternativas.a: Uma pessoa em quem se confiam segredos, sentido que o texto rejeita.
alternativas.b: Alguém que trabalha como conselheiro profissional.
alternativas.c: Alguém que se sente seguro de si mesmo ou de um resultado.
alternativas.d: Uma pessoa desconfiada de tudo ao seu redor, sentido oposto ao do texto.

questoes.explicacao: O texto explica que 'confident' significa confiante/seguro de si, e não 'confidente' (pessoa de confiança para segredos), que em inglês corresponde a 'confidant'.

questoes.texto_apoio: Some countries have passed 'right to disconnect' laws, which prohibit employers from contacting staff outside working hours except in genuine emergencies. Advocates argue the laws protect workers' mental health and personal time, while some business groups claim the rules add unnecessary rigidity to industries that require flexibility.
questoes.enunciado: What is the main idea of the text?

alternativas.a: Right to disconnect laws require employees to work overtime without pay, contrary to the text.
alternativas.b: Right to disconnect laws require workers to remain reachable at all times, even outside working hours.
alternativas.c: Right to disconnect laws limit after-hours contact from employers, a measure that has generated both support and criticism.
alternativas.d: Business groups created these laws specifically to give workers more flexibility during working hours.

questoes.explicacao: O texto apresenta o objetivo das leis de desconexão (limitar contato fora do horário de trabalho) e as reações divergentes: apoio de defensores dos trabalhadores e crítica de alguns grupos empresariais.

questoes.texto_apoio: Industry reports estimate that the equivalent of one garbage truck of textiles is landfilled or incinerated somewhere in the world every single second. At the same time, less than one percent of material used to produce clothing is recycled into new garments, since most fabric blends combine fibers that are difficult to separate.
questoes.enunciado: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the main obstacle to recycling clothing into new garments?

alternativas.a: There is currently no demand at all for recycled clothing materials, which the text does not state.
alternativas.b: The technical difficulty of separating mixed fibers likely limits how much textile waste can be recycled.
alternativas.c: Textile waste is no longer being landfilled or incinerated anywhere in the world, contrary to the text.
alternativas.d: All garments today are made of a single, easily recyclable fiber, an idea the text contradicts.

questoes.explicacao: O texto liga o baixo índice de reciclagem à dificuldade técnica de separar misturas de fibras nos tecidos, permitindo inferir que esse é um obstáculo central para reciclar roupas em novas peças.

questoes.texto_apoio: The word 'appointment' is a false cognate that can confuse Portuguese speakers. It does not mean 'apontamento' (a note or annotation). Instead, 'appointment' refers to a scheduled meeting, such as a doctor's appointment. The word for 'apontamento' is 'note'.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does the word 'appointment' mean in English?

alternativas.a: Um compromisso agendado, como uma consulta médica.
alternativas.b: Uma anotação breve feita durante uma aula.
alternativas.c: Um documento oficial de nomeação para um cargo público.
alternativas.d: Uma crítica apontada a um projeto.

questoes.explicacao: O texto esclarece que 'appointment' significa um compromisso agendado, e não 'apontamento' (nota/anotação), que em inglês corresponde a 'note'.

questoes.texto_apoio: Charging drivers a fee to enter busy downtown areas during peak hours, a policy known as congestion pricing, has proven polarizing wherever it has been proposed. Supporters point to reduced traffic and cleaner air, while opponents argue it unfairly burdens commuters who have no affordable alternative to driving.
questoes.enunciado: In the text, the word 'polarizing' is closest in meaning to:

alternativas.a: relevant only to a small number of drivers
alternativas.b: universally welcomed without disagreement
alternativas.c: causing sharply divided opinions
alternativas.d: completely forgotten soon after being proposed

questoes.explicacao: O texto mostra opiniões opostas de apoiadores e opositores da política, o que confirma que 'polarizing' significa algo que causa opiniões fortemente divididas.

questoes.texto_apoio: Placing beehives on rooftops has become a popular way to support pollinators in cities, and many urban beekeepers report surprisingly healthy hives, sometimes healthier than those in rural areas with heavy pesticide use. Experts caution, however, that beginners should receive proper training, since poorly managed hives can pose risks to neighbors, especially those with allergies.
questoes.enunciado: What is the main idea of the text?

alternativas.a: Bees in cities are always less healthy than bees in rural areas, contrary to the text.
alternativas.b: Rooftop beehives produce honey that is legally classified as a different product from rural honey.
alternativas.c: Urban beekeeping is entirely risk-free and requires no training whatsoever, contrary to the text.
alternativas.d: Urban beekeeping can benefit pollinators, but proper training is important to manage potential risks.

questoes.explicacao: O texto destaca os benefícios da apicultura urbana para os polinizadores, mas também alerta para a importância do treinamento adequado, dado o risco que colmeias mal manejadas podem representar para vizinhos.

questoes.texto_apoio: Ordinary people around the world are contributing to real scientific research by counting birds in their backyards, photographing plants for identification apps, or reporting weather observations. These citizen science projects have allowed researchers to gather data across enormous geographic areas that would be impossible to cover with professional scientists alone.
questoes.enunciado: What tone does the author adopt when describing citizen science projects?

alternativas.a: Admiring, highlighting the valuable contribution of ordinary participants.
alternativas.b: Dismissive, suggesting that citizen science produces unreliable data.
alternativas.c: Indifferent, presenting the topic with no particular evaluation.
alternativas.d: Alarmed, warning about the dangers of citizen participation in science.

questoes.explicacao: Ao destacar que voluntários permitem coletar dados em escala impossível para cientistas profissionais sozinhos, o autor demonstra um tom de admiração pela contribuição da ciência cidadã.

questoes.texto_apoio: The word 'argument' can be a subtle false cognate. While it can mean a formal, logical 'argumento', in everyday English it more often refers to a heated disagreement or quarrel between people, as in 'the neighbors had a loud argument last night'. Context usually determines which sense applies.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, besides a logical 'argumento', what else can 'argument' mean in everyday English?

alternativas.a: Um acordo formal assinado entre duas partes, sentido ausente do texto.
alternativas.b: Um discurso oficial proferido em um tribunal, sentido que o texto rejeita.
alternativas.c: Um convite formal para um evento social, ideia não mencionada no texto.
alternativas.d: Uma discussão acalorada ou desentendimento entre pessoas.

questoes.explicacao: O texto explica que, no dia a dia, 'argument' frequentemente se refere a uma discussão ou desentendimento entre pessoas, além do sentido de argumento lógico, sendo importante observar o contexto para identificar o significado pretendido.

questoes.texto_apoio: In several countries, youth unemployment remains persistently higher than overall unemployment, even during periods of economic growth. Economists point out that young people entering the job market for the first time often lack the specific experience employers request, creating a cycle in which they struggle to gain the very experience needed to be hired.
questoes.enunciado: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the challenge faced by young job seekers?

alternativas.a: A lack of prior experience can create a cycle that makes it difficult for young people to gain the experience employers require.
alternativas.b: Young people find it easier to get hired specifically in countries where the overall economy is growing.
alternativas.c: Youth unemployment disappears completely whenever the overall economy grows, contrary to the text.
alternativas.d: Young people struggle to find jobs mainly because they refuse to accept entry-level positions requiring no experience.

questoes.explicacao: O texto descreve um ciclo em que a falta de experiência dificulta a contratação, e a falta de contratação impede a obtenção de experiência, permitindo inferir a dificuldade estrutural enfrentada por jovens no mercado de trabalho.

questoes.texto_apoio: Wearable devices that track heart rate, sleep patterns, and physical activity have become increasingly popular among people trying to monitor their own health. Doctors note that while these devices can help users notice unusual patterns early, the data should not replace professional medical evaluation, since consumer devices are not always as accurate as clinical equipment.
questoes.enunciado: What is the main idea of the text?

alternativas.a: Doctors recommend that patients rely exclusively on wearable devices instead of medical consultations.
alternativas.b: Wearable devices can be useful for health monitoring, but they should not substitute professional medical care.
alternativas.c: Wearable devices are always more accurate than clinical medical equipment, contrary to the text.
alternativas.d: No one uses wearable devices to monitor sleep or physical activity, which the text disputes.

questoes.explicacao: O texto reconhece a utilidade dos dispositivos vestíveis para identificar padrões incomuns, mas ressalta que eles não devem substituir a avaliação médica profissional, já que podem ser menos precisos que equipamentos clínicos.

questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does 'to assume' most commonly mean in everyday English?

alternativas.a: Admitir publicamente um erro cometido.
alternativas.b: Assumir a responsabilidade formal por um cargo.
alternativas.c: Supor algo sem ter provas concretas.
alternativas.d: Confirmar oficialmente uma informação.

questoes.explicacao: O texto explica que 'to assume' geralmente significa supor algo sem prova, e não 'assumir' no sentido de tomar posse ou admitir, que em inglês correspondem a 'to take on' ou 'to admit'.

questoes.texto_apoio: Toy companies increasingly pay children's content creators to feature products in videos disguised as ordinary play, without clearly disclosing that the content is paid advertising. Child psychologists argue that young viewers, who often cannot distinguish advertising from entertainment, are particularly susceptible to this kind of persuasion.
questoes.enunciado: What tone does the author adopt when describing this type of marketing?

alternativas.a: Approving, praising the creativity of the marketing strategy.
alternativas.b: Critical, raising concern about the vulnerability of child viewers.
alternativas.c: Neutral, simply describing a common business practice with no evaluation.
alternativas.d: Humorous, treating the practice as a lighthearted topic.

questoes.explicacao: Ao citar a preocupação de psicólogos infantis sobre a vulnerabilidade das crianças diante de publicidade disfarçada, o autor adota um tom crítico em relação a essa prática de marketing.

questoes.texto_apoio: In English, 'audience' does not mean 'audiência' in the sense of an official meeting or hearing, such as a court audience. questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does the word 'audience' mean in English?

alternativas.a: Uma reunião oficial marcada por uma autoridade, sentido que o texto rejeita para essa palavra.
alternativas.b: Um processo judicial em andamento, sentido não usado no texto.
alternativas.c: Um documento formal usado em tribunais, ideia ausente do texto.
alternativas.d: O grupo de pessoas que assiste ou ouve uma apresentação, discurso ou transmissão.

questoes.texto_apoio: Marine biologists have discovered that the constant low-frequency noise produced by cargo ships travels enormous distances underwater, overlapping with the frequencies whales use to communicate over long ranges. In busy shipping lanes, some whale populations have been observed calling more loudly and for longer periods, which researchers believe consumes extra energy the animals need for feeding and migration.
questoes.enunciado: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the effect of shipping noise on whale energy budgets?

alternativas.a: Shipping noise only affects whales that no longer migrate, which the text does not state.
alternativas.b: Whales adapting their calls to overcome shipping noise may expend energy that could otherwise support feeding and migration.
alternativas.c: Shipping noise has no measurable effect on how whales communicate, contrary to the text.
alternativas.d: Whales in busy shipping lanes call more quietly and less often in order to conserve energy, contrary to the text.

questoes.explicacao: O texto liga o aumento no volume e na duração dos chamados das baleias ao consumo extra de energia, permitindo inferir que o ruído dos navios pode comprometer recursos energéticos importantes para alimentação e migração.

questoes.texto_apoio: The word 'contest' can be a subtle false cognate. questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does the verb 'to contest' mean in English?

alternativas.a: Responder a uma pergunta em uma prova, sentido que o texto rejeita.
alternativas.b: Participar de uma competição esportiva amistosa.
alternativas.c: Concordar totalmente com uma decisão tomada, sentido oposto ao do texto.
alternativas.d: Desafiar ou contestar formalmente algo, como uma decisão.

questoes.explicacao: O texto explica que 'to contest' significa desafiar ou contestar formalmente algo, e não simplesmente responder a uma pergunta, sentido para o qual o inglês usa 'to answer'.

questoes.texto_apoio: The word 'gratuity' is a formal false cognate for Portuguese speakers. It does not mean 'gratuidade' (something offered free of charge). In English, 'gratuity' means a tip given for a service, as in 'a fifteen percent gratuity was added to the bill'. The word for 'gratuidade' is 'free of charge'.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does the word 'gratuity' mean in English?

alternativas.a: Algo oferecido sem qualquer cobrança.
alternativas.b: Um desconto aplicado em uma compra.
alternativas.c: Um serviço público mantido pelo governo.
alternativas.d: Uma gorjeta dada por um serviço prestado.

questoes.explicacao: O texto esclarece que 'gratuity' significa gorjeta, e não gratuidade (isenção de cobrança), que em inglês corresponde à expressão 'free of charge'.

questoes.texto_apoio: The word 'injury' is a false cognate that can confuse Portuguese speakers. It does not mean 'injúria' (a verbal insult or slander). In English, 'injury' refers to physical harm or damage to the body, as in 'the athlete suffered a serious knee injury'. The word for 'injúria' is 'insult' or 'slander'.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does the word 'injury' mean in English?

alternativas.a: Um dano físico ou machucado no corpo.
alternativas.b: Uma discussão verbal entre duas pessoas.
alternativas.c: Um insulto verbal dirigido a alguém.
alternativas.d: Uma acusação falsa espalhada publicamente.

questoes.explicacao: O texto esclarece que 'injury' significa dano físico/machucado, e não 'injúria' (insulto verbal), que em inglês corresponde a 'insult' ou 'slander'.

questoes.texto_apoio: Companies have deployed AI chatbots to handle routine customer service questions, freeing human agents to focus on more complex cases. Customer satisfaction surveys show mixed results: simple issues, like tracking a package, are often resolved faster than before, but customers report frustration when chatbots fail to understand more nuanced complaints.
questoes.enunciado: What is the main idea of the text?

alternativas.a: Human agents in the text spend most of their time handling simple package-tracking requests.
alternativas.b: AI chatbots were introduced specifically to handle the most complex customer service cases.
alternativas.c: AI chatbots speed up simple requests but can frustrate customers with more complex problems.
alternativas.d: Customer satisfaction surveys show that chatbots resolve complex complaints faster than simple issues like tracking a package.

questoes.explicacao: O texto apresenta um resultado misto: rapidez para questões simples, mas frustração em casos mais complexos, o que resume a ideia central sem indicar substituição total dos atendentes humanos.

questoes.texto_apoio: Tipping, once mostly associated with restaurants and taxis, has spread to an increasing number of services, from coffee shops to self-checkout kiosks that display a suggested gratuity screen before completing a payment. Some consumers report feeling pressured to tip even when no direct service was provided by a person.
questoes.enunciado: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the spread of tipping prompts to self-checkout kiosks?

alternativas.a: Consumers who feel pressured to tip at self-checkout kiosks always receive faster service as a result.
alternativas.b: It may create a sense of social pressure to tip even in situations without meaningful human service.
alternativas.c: It reflects a natural expectation, since self-checkout kiosks always involve direct personal service.
alternativas.d: Tipping prompts appeared at self-checkout kiosks because tipping in restaurants had declined sharply.

questoes.explicacao: O texto menciona consumidores que se sentem pressionados a dar gorjeta mesmo sem atendimento direto de uma pessoa, permitindo inferir que essa expansão da prática pode gerar constrangimento social sem justificativa de serviço prestado.

questoes.texto_apoio: In English, 'exit' does not mean 'êxito' (success). 'Exit' refers to the way out of a place, as in 'the emergency exit is on the left'. The word for 'êxito' in the sense of success is 'success'.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does the word 'exit' mean in English?

alternativas.a: Um resultado bem-sucedido em determinada área.
alternativas.b: A saída de um lugar.
alternativas.c: Uma vitória em uma competição.
alternativas.d: Um evento comemorativo de conquista.

questoes.explicacao: O texto esclarece que 'exit' significa saída, e não 'êxito' (sucesso), que em inglês corresponde à palavra 'success'.

questoes.texto_apoio: The word 'idiom' is a false cognate that can trip up Portuguese speakers. It does not mean 'idioma' (a language). In English, 'idiom' refers to a fixed expression whose meaning cannot be understood from its individual words, such as 'it's raining cats and dogs'. The word for 'idioma' is 'language'.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does the word 'idiom' mean in English?

alternativas.a: Um idioma ou língua falada por um país, sentido que o texto rejeita.
alternativas.b: Um dialeto regional de determinada língua, ideia ausente do texto.
alternativas.c: Uma expressão fixa cujo sentido não pode ser deduzido das palavras individuais.
alternativas.d: Um erro comum de pronúncia entre estrangeiros, sentido não usado no texto.

questoes.explicacao: O texto explica que 'idiom' se refere a uma expressão idiomática, e não a um idioma/língua, que em inglês corresponde à palavra 'language'.

questoes.texto_apoio: The word 'prejudice' can be a subtle false cognate. While related to 'prejuízo', 'prejudice' in English usually refers to an unfair, preconceived opinion about a person or group, not to a financial loss. The word for a financial loss, as in 'prejuízo financeiro', is 'loss' or 'damage'.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does the word 'prejudice' most commonly mean in English?

alternativas.a: Uma multa aplicada por descumprimento contratual.
alternativas.b: Um prejuízo financeiro sofrido por uma empresa, sentido que o texto rejeita.
alternativas.c: Uma opinião preconcebida e injusta sobre uma pessoa ou grupo.
alternativas.d: Um dano material causado por um acidente, ideia ausente do texto.

questoes.explicacao: O texto esclarece que 'prejudice' geralmente se refere a preconceito, uma opinião injusta e preconcebida, e não a prejuízo financeiro, que em inglês corresponde a 'loss' ou 'damage'.

questoes.texto_apoio: After three consecutive years of below-average rainfall, farmers in the region harvested a meager crop, far below what was needed to cover basic production costs. Many were forced to sell livestock or seek loans just to survive until the next planting season, hoping for more favorable weather.
questoes.enunciado: In the text, the word 'meager' is closest in meaning to:

alternativas.a: abundant and more than sufficient
alternativas.b: perfectly average, as expected
alternativas.c: small and insufficient
alternativas.d: unusually profitable

questoes.explicacao: O contexto indica que a colheita ficou 'muito abaixo do necessário' para cobrir custos, o que reforça o sentido de 'meager' como algo pequeno e insuficiente.

questoes.texto_apoio: Messages promising guaranteed returns of 'ten times your investment in just one week' continue to spread rapidly online, often accompanied by testimonials that turn out to be fabricated. Financial regulators repeatedly warn that any investment promising unusually high, risk-free returns should be treated with extreme suspicion.
questoes.enunciado: What tone does the author adopt when describing these investment messages?

alternativas.a: Indifferent, presenting the topic without any evaluation.
alternativas.b: Celebratory, praising the success of these investment schemes.
alternativas.c: Skeptical, warning readers about the likelihood of fraud.
alternativas.d: Trusting, encouraging readers to invest as quickly as possible.

questoes.explicacao: Ao mencionar depoimentos forjados e o alerta de reguladores financeiros sobre retornos altos e sem risco, o autor adota um tom claramente cético em relação a esse tipo de mensagem de investimento.

questoes.texto_apoio: As countries invest heavily in solar and wind power, new jobs have appeared in manufacturing, installation, and maintenance of renewable energy equipment. At the same time, regions historically dependent on coal mining or oil extraction face job losses, and workers there often lack the specific training required for the new renewable energy positions being created elsewhere.
questoes.enunciado: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the transition from fossil fuel jobs to renewable energy jobs?

alternativas.a: Most displaced fossil fuel workers already have the exact training required for the new renewable energy jobs being created.
alternativas.b: Renewable energy investment has not created any new jobs so far, contrary to the text's description.
alternativas.c: Coal mining regions have experienced no economic impact from the shift to renewable energy, contrary to the text.
alternativas.d: The transition may create a mismatch between the skills of displaced fossil fuel workers and the requirements of new renewable energy jobs.

questoes.explicacao: O texto contrasta a criação de empregos em energias renováveis com a perda de empregos em regiões dependentes de combustíveis fósseis, destacando a falta de treinamento específico, o que permite inferir um descompasso entre habilidades antigas e novas exigências do mercado.

questoes.texto_apoio: Advertising revenue for podcasts has grown steadily as listeners spend more time with the format during commutes and workouts. Unlike traditional radio, podcast hosts often read advertisements themselves, in a conversational tone, which many brands believe builds more trust with audiences than a standard prerecorded commercial.
questoes.enunciado: What is the main idea of the text?

alternativas.a: Podcast advertising has grown, partly because host-read ads are seen as building more trust with listeners.
alternativas.b: Podcast advertising has grown mainly because it costs significantly less than traditional radio advertising.
alternativas.c: Listeners avoid podcasts specifically because of their advertisements.
alternativas.d: Podcast advertising has declined sharply due to competition from traditional radio.

questoes.explicacao: O texto explica que a receita publicitária em podcasts cresceu, destacando que a leitura dos anúncios pelos próprios apresentadores, em tom conversacional, é vista como um fator que constrói mais confiança com o público.

questoes.texto_apoio: City officials in several metropolitan areas have reported a noticeable increase in rat sightings in recent years. Researchers studying the trend point to a combination of factors, including warmer winters that allow rats to remain active year-round and inconsistent enforcement of rules requiring restaurants and households to store food waste in sealed containers.
questoes.enunciado: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the causes of rising rat populations in cities?

alternativas.a: Rat populations are declining, according to city officials, contrary to the text.
alternativas.b: The increase likely results from a combination of climate patterns and gaps in food waste management.
alternativas.c: Warmer winters are the only factor mentioned as contributing to the trend, contrary to the text.
alternativas.d: City officials report that food waste is now completely irrelevant to the rise in rat sightings.

questoes.explicacao: O texto menciona dois fatores combinados — invernos mais quentes e fiscalização inconsistente do armazenamento de lixo orgânico — permitindo inferir que o aumento das populações de ratos resulta da combinação desses elementos, não de um único fator isolado.

questoes.texto_apoio: In English, 'large' does not mean 'largo' (wide). 'Large' refers to size in general, as in 'a large house', while 'largo', in the sense of width, corresponds to 'wide' in English, as in 'a wide street'.

alternativas.a: Tall
alternativas.b: Wide
alternativas.c: Large

questoes.explicacao: O texto esclarece que 'large' se refere a tamanho em geral (grande), enquanto o sentido de 'largo' (largura) corresponde à palavra 'wide' em inglês.

questoes.texto_apoio: Cocoa prices spiked to record levels after poor harvests in the main producing regions, driven by unusually heavy rainfall and the spread of a crop disease. Chocolate manufacturers warned that the higher costs would likely be passed on to consumers, with some brands already reducing the size of their products instead of raising prices directly.
questoes.enunciado: In the text, the word 'spiked' is closest in meaning to:

alternativas.a: remained completely stable
alternativas.b: disappeared from the market entirely
alternativas.c: decreased gradually over several months
alternativas.d: rose sharply and suddenly

questoes.explicacao: O contexto associa 'spiked' a preços recordes após más colheitas, indicando um aumento súbito e acentuado, e não uma queda ou estabilidade.

questoes.texto_apoio: Audiobooks have become one of the fastest-growing segments of the publishing industry, appealing to commuters and multitaskers who want to enjoy books while driving or doing chores. Some authors have noted that narration style can significantly affect how a story is received, leading publishers to invest heavily in choosing the right voice for each title.
questoes.enunciado: What is the main idea of the text?

alternativas.a: Audiobooks are declining in popularity compared to printed books, contrary to the text.
alternativas.b: Publishers have stopped investing in audiobook production entirely, which the text disputes.
alternativas.c: Audiobooks are growing rapidly, and narration quality has become an important factor in their success.
alternativas.d: Audiobooks can only be enjoyed by people who are not doing any other activity.

questoes.explicacao: O texto descreve o crescimento dos audiolivros e destaca a importância da narração para o sucesso do produto, motivando investimento das editoras na escolha da voz adequada.

questoes.texto_apoio: Glasses marketed to block blue light from screens have become popular among people who spend long hours in front of computers, with sellers claiming they reduce eye strain and improve sleep. However, several independent studies have found no significant difference in eye strain between people who wear the glasses and those who do not, while other smaller studies report modest benefits.
questoes.enunciado: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the scientific consensus on blue light glasses?

alternativas.a: The evidence remains mixed, with some studies finding no significant benefit and others reporting modest effects.
alternativas.b: Every independent study mentioned in the text confirms that blue light glasses significantly reduce eye strain.
alternativas.c: Blue light glasses have been proven to cause eye strain rather than reduce it, contrary to the text.
alternativas.d: All scientific studies agree completely that blue light glasses are highly effective.

questoes.explicacao: O texto apresenta resultados contraditórios entre diferentes estudos, permitindo inferir que ainda não há consenso científico sobre a real eficácia dos óculos que bloqueiam luz azul.

questoes.texto_apoio: The word 'record' can confuse Portuguese speakers depending on context. As a verb, 'to record' means to capture sound or video, similar to 'gravar'. alternativas.d: Capturar som ou vídeo, no sentido de gravar.

questoes.texto_apoio: Consumer advocates have long criticized manufacturers for designing products, from smartphones to household appliances, that are difficult or impossible to repair and that stop receiving software updates after just a few years, forcing customers to buy replacements far sooner than necessary. Some manufacturers deny doing this deliberately, attributing shorter product lifespans to genuine technical limitations.
questoes.enunciado: What tone does the author adopt when describing this design practice?

alternativas.a: Critical, highlighting consumer complaints about products designed to become obsolete quickly.
alternativas.b: Indifferent, presenting no evaluation of the practice, unlike the actual tone.
alternativas.c: Comedic, treating the issue as unimportant, unlike the critical tone used.
alternativas.d: Fully supportive, praising manufacturers for their innovation, opposite to the tone.

questoes.explicacao: Ao expor as críticas de defensores do consumidor sobre produtos difíceis de reparar e que perdem suporte rapidamente, o autor adota um tom crítico em relação a essa prática, mesmo mencionando a versão dos fabricantes.

questoes.texto_apoio: The word 'cigar' is a false cognate for Portuguese speakers. It does not mean 'cigarro' (cigarette). A 'cigar' is a thick roll of tobacco leaves smoked without paper, typically associated with celebrations. The word for 'cigarro', the thin, paper-wrapped kind, is 'cigarette'.
questoes.enunciado: According to the text, what does the word 'cigar' mean in English?

alternativas.a: Um charuto, rolo grosso de folhas de tabaco.
alternativas.b: Um cachimbo usado para fumar tabaco.
alternativas.c: Um isqueiro utilizado para acender cigarros.
alternativas.d: Um cigarro fino, enrolado em papel.

questoes.explicacao: O texto esclarece que 'cigar' significa charuto, e não cigarro (fino e envolto em papel), que em inglês corresponde a 'cigarette'.

questoes.texto_apoio: As tools capable of generating original songs from simple text prompts become more sophisticated, record labels and musicians are pushing courts to clarify who owns the rights to AI-generated music, especially when the software was trained on existing copyrighted songs without explicit permission from the original artists.
questoes.enunciado: What is the main idea of the text?

alternativas.a: AI-generated music has resolved all copyright questions in the music industry, contrary to the text.
alternativas.b: The rise of AI-generated music has raised unresolved legal questions about ownership and the use of copyrighted training material.
alternativas.c: Musicians have stopped worrying about how AI tools use their existing songs, which the text disputes.
alternativas.d: Courts have already ruled that AI-generated music belongs exclusively to the record labels that trained the software.

questoes.explicacao: O texto descreve a busca de gravadoras e músicos por clareza jurídica sobre direitos autorais de músicas geradas por IA, especialmente quando treinadas com músicas protegidas sem autorização, evidenciando uma questão legal ainda não resolvida.

questoes.texto_apoio: The reintroduction of large predators to areas where they had been absent for decades has helped restore balance to local ecosystems, controlling populations of deer and other herbivores that had overgrazed vegetation. At the same time, ranchers near these areas report occasional losses of livestock, prompting some governments to create compensation funds to offset the cost to farmers.
questoes.enunciado: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the overall approach taken toward predator reintroduction programs?

alternativas.a: Programs appear to balance ecological benefits with efforts to mitigate the economic impact on local ranchers.
alternativas.b: Compensation funds were created because ranchers demanded the complete removal of the reintroduced predators.
alternativas.c: Predator reintroduction programs have caused ranchers to permanently give up raising livestock in affected areas.
alternativas.d: Ranchers welcomed the return of predators mainly because it eliminated overgrazing problems affecting their own livestock.

questoes.explicacao: O texto apresenta tanto o benefício ecológico da reintrodução de predadores quanto o prejuízo ocasional a pecuaristas, e menciona fundos de compensação, permitindo inferir uma tentativa de equilibrar ambos os interesses.

questoes.texto_apoio: The word 'spectacles' is an old-fashioned but still used false cognate. It does not mean 'espetáculos' (shows or performances). alternativas.a: Apresentações teatrais ou musicais.
alternativas.b: Eventos esportivos de grande porte.
alternativas.c: Óculos de grau.
alternativas.d: Fogos de artifício em uma celebração.

questoes.explicacao: O texto explica que, no inglês britânico, 'spectacles' pode significar óculos de grau, e não espetáculos (shows), que em inglês correspondem a 'show' ou 'performance'.

questoes.texto_apoio: As more stores stop accepting cash in favor of card and mobile payments, advocacy groups have raised concerns about elderly customers and low-income residents who rely on cash and may not have access to banking services or smartphones. Some cities have responded by passing laws requiring businesses to accept cash as a form of payment.
questoes.enunciado: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the groups most affected by the decline of cash payments?

alternativas.a: Cashless policies affect all customers equally, regardless of age or income, contrary to the text.
alternativas.b: Elderly and low-income individuals without banking access may be disproportionately excluded by cashless policies.
alternativas.c: Cashless policies have been embraced without any concerns from advocacy groups, which the text disputes.
alternativas.d: Only wealthy customers are affected by the shift toward cashless payments, an idea the text contradicts.

questoes.explicacao: O texto conecta a preocupação de grupos de defesa a idosos e pessoas de baixa renda sem acesso bancário, permitindo inferir que esses grupos são desproporcionalmente afetados pela redução do uso de dinheiro em espécie.

questoes.texto_apoio: As solar panel installations from a decade ago begin reaching the end of their lifespan, the industry faces a growing challenge: there is currently limited infrastructure to recycle the glass, silicon, and metals inside old panels, and many end up in landfills instead of being processed into materials for new panels.
questoes.enunciado: What is the main idea of the text?

alternativas.a: Only solar panels installed in sunny regions eventually need to be recycled.
alternativas.b: Most solar panels reaching the end of their lifespan are already being processed into materials for new panels.
alternativas.c: The solar industry faces a recycling challenge as aging panels reach the end of their useful life.
alternativas.d: The materials inside old solar panels, such as glass and silicon, have no value and are not worth recycling.

questoes.explicacao: O texto descreve o desafio emergente de reciclar painéis solares antigos, apontando a falta de infraestrutura adequada como o problema central discutido.

questoes.texto_apoio: Popular destinations that once welcomed tourism as an economic blessing are now struggling with its consequences: overcrowded streets, rising housing costs for locals pushed out by short-term rentals, and natural sites damaged by the sheer volume of visitors. Some cities have begun limiting daily visitor numbers or taxing tourists directly to fund infrastructure repairs.
questoes.enunciado: What tone does the author adopt when describing the effects of overtourism?

alternativas.a: Enthusiastic, celebrating the growth of the tourism industry, unlike the actual tone.
alternativas.b: Indifferent, presenting tourism growth with no evaluation, unlike the concerned tone.
alternativas.c: Concerned, highlighting the negative consequences faced by popular destinations.
alternativas.d: Mocking, ridiculing tourists for visiting popular places, unlike the tone used.

questoes.explicacao: Ao listar consequências negativas como superlotação, aumento do custo de moradia e danos a sítios naturais, o autor demonstra um tom de preocupação em relação aos efeitos do overtourism.

questoes.texto_apoio: Schools experimenting with virtual reality headsets report that students find immersive simulations, such as walking through a recreation of ancient Rome, more engaging than reading the same content in a textbook. Teachers note, however, that the technology remains expensive and requires additional staff training to use effectively in a classroom setting.
questoes.enunciado: In the text, the word 'immersive' is closest in meaning to:

questoes.texto_apoio: Animal shelters in several countries reported a sharp rise in pet adoptions during periods when large numbers of employees began working from home. questoes.texto_apoio: Apps offering AI-powered companions designed to chat, listen, and offer emotional support have grown popular among users who describe feeling less alone after using them. alternativas.d: Sob o efeito de álcool, embriagado.
